column2:
salute(n./v.)敬禮、致敬、表揚
(無詞性變化)
military salute 軍禮
salute the flag 向國旗敬禮
The soldiers saluted the general as he walked past them.
(將軍經過時，士兵們向他敬禮。)
The ceremony was held to salute the doctors and nurses who fought the pandemic.
(這場典禮是為了向對抗疫情的醫護人員致敬而舉辦的。)

salvage(v.)搶救、挽救、打撈
salvation(n.)拯救、救助
salvage operation 打撈行動
salvage the situation 挽救局面
Divers tried to salvage valuable items from the sunken ship.
(潛水員試著從沉船中打撈有價值的物品。)
The coach made several changes to salvage the team's disappointing season.
(教練做了幾項調整，試圖挽救球隊令人失望的球季。)

sanitation(n.)公共衛生、衛生設備
sanitary(adj.)衛生的、清潔的
sanitize(v.)消毒
poor sanitation 衛生條件不佳
sanitation worker 清潔隊員
Poor sanitation can lead to the spread of serious diseases.
(衛生條件不佳可能導致嚴重疾病的散播。)
Sanitation workers collect garbage in our neighborhood every evening.
(清潔隊員每天傍晚到我們社區收垃圾。)

savage(adj./n./v.)野蠻的、兇猛的、野蠻人、猛烈攻擊
savagely(adv.)兇猛地、殘忍地
savagery(n.)野蠻、殘暴
savage attack 兇猛的攻擊
savage criticism 猛烈的批評
The villagers were frightened by the savage attack of the wild dogs.
(村民們被野狗兇猛的攻擊嚇壞了。)
The director's new film was savaged by critics.
(這位導演的新片遭到影評人猛烈抨擊。)

scenic(adj.)風景優美的、景色的
scene(n.)景色、場景
scenery(n.)風景
scenic spot 風景區、景點
scenic route 景觀路線
Sun Moon Lake is one of the most popular scenic spots in Taiwan.
(日月潭是臺灣最受歡迎的風景區之一。)
We took the scenic route along the east coast instead of the highway.
(我們沒走高速公路，而是沿著東海岸走景觀路線。)

scorn(n./v.)輕蔑、鄙視、不屑
scornful(adj.)輕蔑的
pour scorn on 對……嗤之以鼻
with scorn 輕蔑地
Some people poured scorn on his idea, but it turned out to be a great success.
(有些人對他的點子嗤之以鼻，但結果卻非常成功。)
She scorned the offer because she thought it was unfair.
(她不屑這個提議，因為她認為它不公平。)

scrape(v./n.)刮、擦傷、刮擦聲、困境
scraper(n.)刮刀
scrape off 刮掉
scrape through 勉強通過
He scraped the old paint off the wall before repainting it.
(他重新油漆前先把牆上的舊漆刮掉。)
She fell off her bike and scraped her knee on the road.
(她從腳踏車上摔下來，膝蓋在路面上擦傷了。)

screwdriver(n.)螺絲起子
screw(n./v.)螺絲、旋緊
electric screwdriver 電動螺絲起子
use a screwdriver 用螺絲起子
You will need a small screwdriver to open the back of the remote control.
(你需要一支小的螺絲起子才能打開遙控器的背蓋。)
He tightened the loose screws with a screwdriver.
(他用螺絲起子把鬆掉的螺絲鎖緊。)

scroll(n./v.)卷軸、捲動(螢幕)
(無詞性變化)
scroll down 向下捲動
ancient scroll 古代卷軸
Scroll down to the bottom of the page to find the contact information.
(往下捲動到頁面底部就能找到聯絡資訊。)
The museum displays ancient scrolls painted during the Song dynasty.
(博物館展出宋代繪製的古代卷軸。)

scrutiny(n.)仔細檢查、審查
scrutinize(v.)仔細檢查、審視
under scrutiny 受到審查
close scrutiny 嚴密檢視
The government's new policy is under close scrutiny by the public.
(政府的新政策正受到大眾的嚴密檢視。)
Every detail of the report was subject to careful scrutiny.
(報告中的每個細節都經過仔細審查。)

sculptor(n.)雕刻家、雕塑家
sculpture(n.)雕刻、雕塑品
sculpt(v.)雕刻、雕塑
famous sculptor 知名雕塑家
wood sculptor 木雕師
Ju Ming is a world-famous Taiwanese sculptor known for his Taichi series.
(朱銘是世界知名的臺灣雕塑家，以太極系列聞名。)
The sculptor spent three years completing the giant stone statue.
(這位雕刻家花了三年完成那座巨大的石像。)

seagull(n.)海鷗
gull(n.)海鷗(同 seagull)
a flock of seagulls 一群海鷗
seagulls circling 海鷗盤旋
A flock of seagulls followed the fishing boat back to the harbor.
(一群海鷗跟著漁船回到港口。)
Be careful, or the gulls might steal the food from your hand.
(小心點，否則海鷗可能會搶走你手中的食物。)

seduce(v.)引誘、誘惑、勾引
seduction(n.)誘惑
seductive(adj.)誘人的
be seduced by 被……誘惑
seduce customers 吸引顧客
Many young people are seduced by the promise of easy money.
(許多年輕人被輕鬆賺錢的承諾所誘惑。)
The store uses bright lights and music to seduce customers into buying more.
(這家店利用明亮的燈光和音樂來吸引顧客多買一些。)

selective(adj.)有選擇性的、挑剔的
select(v.)挑選
selection(n.)選擇、精選
selectively(adv.)選擇性地
selective memory 選擇性記憶
be selective about 對……很挑剔
He seems to have a selective memory when it comes to his promises.
(說到他的承諾，他似乎有選擇性記憶。)
She is very selective about the friends she spends time with.
(她對於要和哪些朋友相處非常挑剔。)

serene(adj.)寧靜的、安詳的、平靜的
serenity(n.)寧靜、平靜
serenely(adv.)安詳地
serene smile 安詳的微笑
serene lake 寧靜的湖泊
The serene lake reflected the mountains like a mirror.
(寧靜的湖面像鏡子一樣映照出群山。)
Despite the chaos around her, she remained calm and serene.
(儘管周遭一片混亂，她依然冷靜而安詳。)

sergeant(n.)士官、中士、巡佐
(無詞性變化)
police sergeant 警佐
drill sergeant 教育班長
The drill sergeant shouted orders at the new soldiers.
(教育班長對著新兵大聲下達命令。)
He was promoted to sergeant after five years of service.
(服役五年後，他晉升為士官。)

serial(adj.)連續的、一系列的、連載的
series(n.)系列、連續
serial number 序號
serial killer 連續殺人犯
Please write down the serial number printed on the back of the device.
(請寫下印在裝置背面的序號。)
The novel was first published as a serial in a weekly magazine.
(這部小說最初是在週刊上連載的。)

sermon(n.)講道、說教
(無詞性變化)
deliver a sermon 講道
preach a sermon 布道
The priest delivered a moving sermon about forgiveness.
(神父發表了一場關於寬恕的感人講道。)
I don't need another sermon about my messy room.
(我不需要再聽一次有關我房間亂七八糟的說教。)

serving(n.)一份(食物)
serve(v.)供應、服務
server(n.)服務生、伺服器
a serving of 一份
second serving 第二份、再來一份
Doctors recommend eating at least five servings of fruit and vegetables a day.
(醫生建議每天至少吃五份蔬果。)
The cake was so delicious that everyone asked for a second serving.
(蛋糕太好吃了，每個人都要求再來一份。)

setback(n.)挫折、阻礙、倒退
(無詞性變化)
suffer a setback 遭遇挫折
major setback 重大挫折
The team suffered a major setback when their best player got injured.
(最佳球員受傷，讓球隊遭受重大挫折。)
Don't let one small setback stop you from chasing your dreams.
(別讓一次小挫折阻止你追逐夢想。)

shabby(adj.)破舊的、衣衫襤褸的、卑劣的
shabbily(adv.)破舊地、卑鄙地
shabby clothes 破舊的衣服
shabby treatment 不公平的待遇
The old man wore a shabby coat with holes in the sleeves.
(那位老人穿著一件袖子有破洞的破舊外套。)
The employees complained about the shabby treatment they received from the company.
(員工們抱怨公司對他們的不公平待遇。)

sharpen(v.)削尖、磨利、使敏銳、加強
sharp(adj.)鋒利的、敏銳的
sharpener(n.)削鉛筆機、磨刀器
sharpen a pencil 削鉛筆
sharpen one's skills 精進技能
Please sharpen your pencils before the exam begins.
(考試開始前請先把鉛筆削好。)
Reading English newspapers can help you sharpen your language skills.
(閱讀英文報紙可以幫助你精進語言能力。)

shaver(n.)電動刮鬍刀
shave(v./n.)刮鬍子、剃
electric shaver 電動刮鬍刀
rechargeable shaver 充電式刮鬍刀
My father bought a new electric shaver for his business trip.
(我爸爸為了出差買了一支新的電動刮鬍刀。)
Remember to charge your shaver before you pack it.
(打包前記得把刮鬍刀充好電。)

shortcoming(n.)缺點、短處
(無詞性變化)
overcome shortcomings 克服缺點
serious shortcoming 嚴重缺陷
Everyone has shortcomings, but we can learn to improve them.
(每個人都有缺點，但我們可以學著改進。)
The report pointed out several shortcomings in the new system.
(報告指出了新系統的幾項缺陷。)

shortsighted(adj.)近視的、目光短淺的
shortsightedness(n.)近視、短視
shortsighted policy 短視的政策
shortsighted view 短淺的看法
Cutting the education budget would be a shortsighted decision.
(刪減教育預算會是一個目光短淺的決定。)
Many students become shortsighted from staring at screens too long.
(許多學生因長時間盯著螢幕而近視。)

shred(n./v.)碎片、少量、撕碎、切絲
shredder(n.)碎紙機
shred documents 用碎紙機銷毀文件
not a shred of 一點也沒有
The company shreds all confidential documents before throwing them away.
(這家公司在丟棄機密文件前都會先用碎紙機銷毀。)
There is not a shred of evidence to support his claim.
(沒有絲毫證據能支持他的說法。)

shriek(n./v.)尖叫、尖叫聲
(無詞性變化)
shriek with laughter 尖聲大笑
let out a shriek 發出一聲尖叫
The girls shrieked with excitement when their favorite singer appeared on stage.
(最喜歡的歌手登臺時，女孩們興奮地尖叫。)
She let out a shriek when she saw a cockroach in the kitchen.
(她在廚房看到一隻蟑螂時發出一聲尖叫。)

shrub(n.)灌木
shrubbery(n.)灌木叢
plant shrubs 種灌木
evergreen shrub 常綠灌木
The gardener trimmed the shrubs along the path into neat shapes.
(園丁把小徑旁的灌木修剪成整齊的形狀。)
Small birds often build their nests in thick shrubs.
(小鳥常在茂密的灌木中築巢。)

shuffle(v.)洗(牌)、拖著腳走、搬來移去
(無詞性變化)
shuffle the cards 洗牌
shuffle one's feet 拖著腳步走
He shuffled the cards carefully before dealing them to the players.
(他在發牌給玩家前仔細地洗牌。)
The tired old man shuffled slowly across the room.
(那位疲倦的老人拖著腳步慢慢走過房間。)

shutter(n./v.)百葉窗、快門、關閉
(無詞性變化)
shutter speed 快門速度
close the shutters 關上百葉窗
Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving objects.
(攝影師使用高速快門來捕捉移動中的物體。)
We closed the shutters to keep out the strong afternoon sun.
(我們關上百葉窗，擋住午後強烈的陽光。)

simplicity(n.)簡單、樸素、單純
simple(adj.)簡單的
simplify(v.)簡化
for the sake of simplicity 為了簡單起見
beauty of simplicity 簡約之美
The design of the phone is admired for its simplicity and elegance.
(這款手機的設計以簡約優雅受到讚賞。)
For the sake of simplicity, we will round the numbers to whole numbers.
(為了簡單起見，我們會把數字四捨五入到整數。)

simplify(v.)簡化、使簡單
simple(adj.)簡單的
simplification(n.)簡化
simplify the process 簡化流程
greatly simplify 大幅簡化
The new app greatly simplifies the process of booking train tickets.
(這個新應用程式大幅簡化了訂火車票的流程。)
The teacher simplified the story so that younger students could understand it.
(老師簡化了這個故事，讓年紀較小的學生也能理解。)

simultaneous(adj.)同時的、同時發生的
simultaneously(adv.)同時地
simultaneous interpretation 同步口譯
simultaneous events 同時發生的事件
The conference provided simultaneous interpretation in five languages.
(這場會議提供五種語言的同步口譯。)
There were simultaneous protests in several major cities around the world.
(世界上好幾個大城市同時發生了抗議活動。)

skeptical(adj.)懷疑的、多疑的
skeptic(n.)懷疑論者
skepticism(n.)懷疑態度
be skeptical about/of 對……抱持懷疑
remain skeptical 仍持懷疑態度
Many scientists remain skeptical about the claims made in the advertisement.
(許多科學家仍對廣告中的說法抱持懷疑態度。)
I was skeptical of his excuse, but I didn't say anything.
(我對他的藉口半信半疑，但什麼也沒說。)

skim(v./n.)略讀、瀏覽、撇去(浮沫)、掠過
(無詞性變化)
skim through 快速瀏覽
skim milk 脫脂牛奶
Skim through the article first to get the main idea before reading it carefully.
(先快速瀏覽文章抓住大意，再仔細閱讀。)
She skimmed the fat off the top of the soup.
(她撇去湯上面的浮油。)

slang(n./v.)俚語、謾罵
slangy(adj.)俚語的
street slang 街頭俚語
slang word 俚語用字
Teenagers often use slang that their parents do not understand.
(青少年常用父母聽不懂的俚語。)
You should avoid using slang in formal writing.
(在正式寫作中應避免使用俚語。)

slash(v./n.)砍、劃破、大幅削減、斜線
(無詞性變化)
slash prices 大幅降價
slash the budget 大砍預算
The store slashed prices by fifty percent during the year-end sale.
(這家店在年終特賣時降價五成。)
Someone slashed the tires of his car last night.
(昨晚有人劃破了他的車胎。)

slaughter(n./v.)屠宰、屠殺、大敗
slaughterhouse(n.)屠宰場
mass slaughter 大屠殺
slaughter animals 屠宰動物
The farmers slaughter the pigs before the Lunar New Year.
(農民在農曆新年前宰殺豬隻。)
The war led to the slaughter of thousands of innocent people.
(這場戰爭導致數千名無辜民眾慘遭屠殺。)

slay(v.)殺死、殺害
slayer(n.)殺手
slay a dragon 屠龍
be slain in battle 戰死沙場
In the legend, the brave knight slew the dragon and saved the princess.
(傳說中，勇敢的騎士殺死了惡龍並救出公主。)
Thousands of soldiers were slain in the battle.
(數千名士兵在這場戰役中陣亡。)

sloppy(adj.)草率的、邋遢的、稀爛的
sloppily(adv.)草率地
sloppy work 草率的工作
sloppy handwriting 潦草的字跡
The teacher refused to accept the sloppy homework and asked him to do it again.
(老師拒收那份草率的作業，要他重寫。)
His sloppy appearance made a bad impression at the interview.
(他邋遢的外表在面試時給人不好的印象。)

slum(n./v.)貧民窟、過簡陋的生活
(無詞性變化)
live in a slum 住在貧民窟
slum area 貧民區
Millions of people in large cities still live in crowded slums.
(大城市中仍有數百萬人住在擁擠的貧民窟裡。)
The charity builds schools for children in slum areas.
(這個慈善團體為貧民區的孩童興建學校。)

slump(n./v.)暴跌、低迷、癱坐、垂頭
(無詞性變化)
economic slump 經濟衰退
slump in sales 銷售量下滑
The company suffered a sharp slump in sales after the scandal.
(醜聞爆發後，這家公司的銷售量大幅下滑。)
Exhausted after the game, he slumped into a chair.
(比賽後他筋疲力盡地癱坐在椅子上。)

sly(adj.)狡猾的、會意的、淘氣的
slyly(adv.)狡猾地、會心地
sly smile 狡黠的微笑
on the sly 偷偷地
In many fables, the fox is described as a sly animal.
(在許多寓言裡，狐狸都被描寫成狡猾的動物。)
She gave me a sly smile, as if she knew my secret.
(她對我露出狡黠的微笑，好像知道我的祕密似的。)

smuggle(v.)走私、偷帶
smuggler(n.)走私者
smuggling(n.)走私
smuggle drugs 走私毒品
smuggle into 偷運進
Customs officers caught a man trying to smuggle rare birds into the country.
(海關人員逮到一名試圖走私稀有鳥類入境的男子。)
The kids smuggled snacks into the movie theater.
(孩子們偷偷把零食帶進電影院。)

sneaker(n.)運動鞋(單隻)、sneakers(n.)運動鞋(一雙)
sneak(v.)偷偷地走、潛行
a pair of sneakers 一雙運動鞋
running sneakers 跑步鞋
I bought a new pair of sneakers for the school sports day.
(我為了學校運動會買了一雙新的運動鞋。)
Wearing comfortable sneakers is important if you walk a lot.
(如果你常走路，穿一雙舒適的運動鞋很重要。)

sneaky(adj.)鬼鬼祟祟的、偷偷摸摸的、卑鄙的
sneak(v.)偷偷地走、潛行
sneakily(adv.)偷偷地
sneaky trick 卑鄙的伎倆
sneaky way 偷偷摸摸的方式
It was sneaky of him to read my messages without asking.
(他沒問就偷看我的訊息，真是鬼鬼祟祟。)
The advertisement used a sneaky trick to make the price look lower.
(這則廣告用了一個卑劣的伎倆，讓價格看起來比較低。)

sneeze(n./v.)噴嚏、打噴嚏
(無詞性變化)
cough and sneeze 咳嗽和打噴嚏
not to be sneezed at 不可小看
Please cover your mouth when you cough or sneeze.
(咳嗽或打噴嚏時請遮住口鼻。)
A prize of ten thousand dollars is not to be sneezed at.
(一萬元的獎金可不能小看。)

snore(v./n.)打鼾、鼾聲
snoring(n.)打鼾
snore loudly 大聲打鼾
loud snore 很大的鼾聲
My roommate snores so loudly that I can hardly fall asleep.
(我的室友打鼾太大聲，讓我幾乎睡不著。)
His loud snores could be heard from the next room.
(從隔壁房間都能聽到他很大的鼾聲。)

sociable(adj.)好交際的、友善的
society(n.)社會
sociability(n.)社交性、合群
sociable person 好交際的人
sociable atmosphere 融洽的氣氛
She is a sociable person who makes friends easily.
(她是個好交際的人，很容易交到朋友。)
Dolphins are sociable animals that live in groups.
(海豚是群居的社會性動物。)

socialism(n.)社會主義
socialist(n./adj.)社會主義者、社會主義的
democratic socialism 民主社會主義
principles of socialism 社會主義原則
Socialism emphasizes the fair distribution of wealth in society.
(社會主義強調社會財富的公平分配。)
The students compared socialism and capitalism in their history class.
(學生們在歷史課上比較社會主義與資本主義。)

socialist(n.)社會主義者
socialism(n.)社會主義
socialist party 社會黨
socialist country 社會主義國家
